title: Commit Executor Draft PR Ready 2026-07-01
purpose: Make commit_executor handle draft PRs before final merge so green, pipeline-created draft preservation PRs do not require a manual ready-for-review unblock.
evidence_command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_commit_executor_receipt.py::TestDraftPRReadyBeforeMerge --tb=short && python3 -m py_compile mu/tools/executors/commit_executor.py && python3 tools/checks/enforce_l4_execution_contract.py --staged --wave-id commit-executor-draft-pr-ready-2026-07-01 --wave-class L4_ENABLER && git diff --check
evidence_delta: (1) PR #1189 reached green checks and a clean current-head review path, but merge_pr.sh failed because GitHub rejected mergePullRequest while the PR was still draft. (2) The operator manually marked #1189 ready and later pre-marked #1191 ready to prevent the same failure. (3) This wave must make commit_executor detect and transition its own draft PR before final merge, or fail closed with a precise recovery/classification path instead of requiring manual intervention.
progress_proof_before: A green commit_executor run for PR #1189 exited with `merge_pr.sh failed: GraphQL: Pull Request is still a draft (mergePullRequest)`, forcing a manual ready-for-review transition before rerunning the executor.
progress_proof_after: When a commit_executor-owned PR is draft after CI passes and before merge_pr.sh, the executor marks it ready for review or performs an equivalent checked transition, then merges through the normal merge_pr.sh path without manual GitHub intervention.
post_gate_contract_sweep: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_commit_executor_receipt.py --tb=short && python3 tools/checks/enforce_l4_execution_contract.py --staged --wave-id commit-executor-draft-pr-ready-2026-07-01 --wave-class L4_ENABLER && git diff --check
